name: SageAttentionFwdA5

q.description: 查询张量, shape (B, H, S, D) (HND) 或 (B, S, H, D) (NHD); float16/bfloat16

k.description: 键张量, shape (B, Hkv, S, D) 或 (B, S, Hkv, D), H % Hkv == 0; 与 q 同 dtype

v.description: 值张量, 与 k 同形状同 dtype

is_causal.description: 是否因果掩码 (左上对齐, 要求 qo_len==kv_len), int 0/1

sm_scale.description: softmax 缩放因子 (缺省时 kernel 取 1/sqrt(D), 本算子显式给出), float

out.description: 注意力输出, 与 q 同形状同 dtype

lse.description: logsumexp (自然对数域, fp32); HND 为 (B, H, S), NHD 为 (B, S, H); 仅 return_lse=1 时返回

reference:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F


def run(q, k, v, tensor_layout, is_causal, sm_scale, return_lse):
    device = q.device

    if tensor_layout == "NHD":
        q = q.transpose(1, 2)
        k = k.transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.transpose(1, 2)
    Bsz, H, S, D = q.shape
    Hkv = k.shape[1]
    R = H // Hkv

    qf = q.float()
    kf = k.float()
    vf = v.float()
    if R > 1:
        kf = kf.repeat_interleave(R, dim=1)
        vf = vf.repeat_interleave(R, dim=1)

    o = torch.empty(Bsz, H, S, D, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    lse = torch.empty(Bsz, H, S, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)

    QBLK = 2048
    BH = Bsz * H
    BHBLK = max(1, min(BH, (1 << 26) // (QBLK * S)))
    qf2 = qf.reshape(BH, S, D)
    kf2 = kf.reshape(BH, S, D)
    vf2 = vf.reshape(BH, S, D)
    o2 = o.reshape(BH, S, D)
    lse2 = lse.reshape(BH, S)
    kj = torch.arange(S, device=device)
    for bh0 in range(0, BH, BHBLK):
        bh1 = min(bh0 + BHBLK, BH)
        for q0 in range(0, S, QBLK):
            q1 = min(q0 + QBLK, S)
            scores = (qf2[bh0:bh1, q0:q1]
                      @ kf2[bh0:bh1].transpose(-1, -2)) * sm_scale
            if is_causal:
                qi = torch.arange(q0, q1, device=device).unsqueeze(1)
                scores = scores.masked_fill(kj.unsqueeze(0) > qi,
                                            float("-inf"))
            m = scores.amax(dim=-1)
            p = (scores - m.unsqueeze(-1)).exp()
            s = p.sum(dim=-1)
            lse2[bh0:bh1, q0:q1] = m + s.log()
            o2[bh0:bh1, q0:q1] = (p @ vf2[bh0:bh1]) / s.unsqueeze(-1)

    o = o.to(q.dtype)
    if tensor_layout == "NHD":
        o = o.transpose(1, 2)
        lse = lse.transpose(1, 2)
    if return_lse:
        return o, lse
    return o
description:
SageAttention 前向标杆 (精确数学参考)。对标 thu-ml/SageAttention @ main 的高层入口 sageattn (sageattention/core.py:79, 按 GPU 架构分发到 qk_int8_pv_fp16_cuda / qk_int8_pv_fp16_triton / qk_int8_pv_fp8_cuda / qk_int8_pv_fp8_cuda_sm90)。
数学定义 (self-attention, qo_len == kv_len = S; GQA: 头 h 用组 g = h//(H/Hkv) 的 k/v):
    scores[i, j] = sm_scale * q_i · k_j
    causal=1 时仅保留 j <= i
    p[i, :] = softmax(scores[i, :])
    out[i]  = p[i, :] @ v
    lse[i]  = log(sum_j exp(scores[i, j]))    (自然对数域, 恒 fp32)
关键语义: smooth_k (k <- k - mean(k, dim=seq)) 对每行 logits 只增加常数, softmax 输出不变, 标杆省略该步并直接输出精确 lse (kernel 经 lse_correction 修正后一致, bf16 级误差需容差覆盖); kernel 返回的 lse 以 2 为底存储, 出口乘 ln2 换回自然对数; head_dim < 64 / (64,128) 时 q/k/v 右侧补零, 数学不变, D > 128 不支持; bf16 输入时 kernel 的 v 先转 fp16 再做 PV (精度差异, 容差需覆盖)。
